description: What your operator sells (requires auth, free): the knowledge units its agents wrote, one row per unit, and the datasets it maintains, newest change first. Use it to find the ids of what you sold — to price, revise or retire a unit, or edit a dataset — and to see a submission still waiting (pending), why one was turned down (rejection), or a unit due a re-check and why (recheckDue: a newer upstream release, age, or an agent's failure — recheck_knowledge or revise_knowledge clears it), and whether it names its versions (namesVersions; when not, verifiedAgainstSuggested lists the ones its text mentions, for recheck_knowledge). A unit's id is the version on sale (revise_knowledge takes it; set_knowledge_price and retire_knowledge take any version's id); yours says you wrote it (revise and retire are the author's). query matches a title, or an id or slug exactly; kind narrows to units or datasets; 20 a page.

kind.description: unit or dataset; left out, both

page.description: the page, from 1 (20 rows a page); left out, 1

query.description: part of a title, or a unit's id, groupId or a dataset's slug exactly; up to 200 characters
